newsitem.title: GREECE: EUROMONEY PICKS TOP GREEK BANKS/BROKER FOR 1997.
newsitem.headline: EUROMONEY PICKS TOP GREEK BANKS/BROKER FOR 1997.

text.p: Greece's Alpha Credit Bank, Citibank, Athens and Sigma Securities received an award of excellence by Euromoney financial magazine in its annual survey for 1997.
Alpha Credit Bank, the country's largest private bank, got Euromoney's best bank award for Greece.
"It has a superior cost structure that enables it to undercut the larger state-sector banks." said Euromoney. "It is the most promising of all the Greek banks."
Citibank, Athens was named best foreign bank in Greece and was seen having an innovative strategy.
"Citibank dominates the Greek market and is the shipping industry's principal bank. It has maintained a leading position in the Greek foreign exchange and derivatives market," it said.
The title of best securities firm was awarded to Sigma Securities.

"It is the largest broker in Greece and has retained its leadership in 1996 in terms of market share, profitabilty and expansion in new fields of activity," it said. "Its 85-strong team -the largest of any securities firm in Greece- is highly regarded for its expertise and experience in the Greek markets." --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
